release_notes:
Fix fresh-install breakage: template.sql column mismatch, ini comment syntax

tbl_gf_email_settings seed INSERT was short 6 values (102 vs 108 columns)
after four migrations added columns without updating this row — every
fresh install failed at schema import with "Column count doesn't match
value count". Backfilled the missing values from each migration's own
DEFAULT.

install.sh's 99-gsmtool.ini heredoc used '#' comments; PHP's ini parser
choked on the parenthesis in one of them ("syntax error, unexpected '('"),
breaking CLI PHP on every install. Switched to ';' comments.

Also: stopped swallowing the schema-import error with 2>/dev/null (it was
hiding the real cause above), and fixed the ERR trap to report the actual
failing line via BASH_LINENO instead of the trap handler's own line.
